notes.title: The devs behind Nine Sols tease a possible follow-up with a mysterious, fictitious, creepypasta video essay
notes.content:
It is always an exciting time when Red Candle Games are up to something. The sheer variety they've put on display with Detention, Devotion, and most recently Nine Sols is nothing to sniff at. Now, it appears they're gearing up for the next project in an appropriately mysterious way. Earlier today, the official Red Candle Games YouTube channel shared a video titled "The Dark Legacy of the Sun Tribe," and it certainly is… something.

Read more

notes.title: [5457306] Closed Beta#3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed some English text displays.
Fixed a bug where taking the elevator repeatedly caused the main character to disappear.
Fixed a bug in the “Cortex Center” that prevented progress from advancing.
Fixed a bug where the character was not given a bow and arrows.
Fixed an issue where certain objects were floating in mid-air.
Fixed a bug where Shen Nong (the character’s name) could cure poison status on his own.
Fixed an issue where fire damage could not be triggered.
Fixed a bug where the Iron Skin Jade caused the character to become invincible and not die.
Fixed a bug where the Jade of Medicine caused the player’s actions to get stuck while healing.

notes.title: Notice for Beta Test III
notes.content:
[h2]Important Notes[/h2]

The content of this beta #3 is close to 2/3 of the final game, but many parts and features are not yet perfected. Therefore, we suggest that those players who do not wish to be spoiled and who want to experience more complete content may skip it for now. This beta is mainly for players who wish to participate in the development process and want to provide feedback/suggestions.

The close beta test build is still in development and may differ from the final release.

The beta redeem keys are exclusive to backers who participated in the Nine Sols crowdfunding campaign with tiers including beta test access.

The close beta test build is not permanently available. The build may get pulled from all platforms with prior notice.

The beta build may cause unexpected errors or contain game-crashing bugs. However, due to the nature of this build (for playtest purposes) the dev team can only provide supports that we deem necessary.

Considering the dialogues and texts in-game have not been finalized, the dev team did not adjust the translated texts in detail, please understand that many typos and other localization issues might occur.

The saved data from this test build cannot be transferred or applied to the final release.

The dev team may perform an emergency update without notice during the beta test.

It is prohibited to sell the Steam key of the Nine Sols beta test to others.

The dev team will collect the players’ data to analyze and improve the content.

Please be sure to completely uninstall the beta build after the end of the test to avoid unexpected errors in the later build.

Use a controller for the best experience.

We do not recommend live streaming or recording Beta #3 content, but sharing relative content in related Discord channels is welcome.

Feel free to discuss and share any suggestions and comments about the beta test build on the beta-test-only channel in Red Candle Games Official Discord Channel. Message us through Discord’s #contact-us channel is also welcome.

The dev team does not guarantee that all feedback from the beta test will be applied in the final release. Thank you for your understanding.

[h2]What’s Included in the Beta Test Build[/h2]

The beta test build includes several brand-new areas, new enemies, mini-bosses, and boss fights.
